title: Majority head coalition
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, the majority-head coalition is the set of coordinate positions obtained by applying the majority-head embedding to every position among the $k+m$ coordinates.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the majority-head embedding, so its mathematical meaning cannot be described more precisely.
